title: DrivingEditor · seed0 50k 恢复训练链

paper_metrics.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of per-frame PSNR, later macro-average scenes equally.
paper_metrics.perfect_error_policy: Zero-error frames have infinite mathematical PSNR; saved as null and counted separately, excluded from finite mean.
paper_metrics.mask_protocol: Explicit binary actor masks, union optional separately predicted shadows; nearest-neighbor resize.
paper_metrics.interpretation: PSNR* uses composite RGB on dynamic region. PSNR-S uses composite RGB on static region. PSNR-SR uses static-branch RGB on the same static region after deleting all dynamic Gaussians.
limitations: Paper masked-PSNR normalization is unspecified; both ROI and full-image zero-padded conventions are reported.
No deletion-hole quality is measured: historical unobstructed GT is required for Table V.
Inferred/prepared masks are not independent manually annotated ground truth.

lineage.description: Parent10k remains at its original path. Only child20k/30k/40k/50k are newly produced after genuine restore.

notes: 所有节点使用同一相机、同一帧顺序；视频按10fps播放，模型时间另行记录。
移除动态视图直接使用独立静态分支；Static与Removed是同一个结果，不是两次实验。
全图 PSNR / SSIM / LPIPS 始终评估 Composite，与视频显示模式无关；指标来自训练视角，单场景不能代替论文四场景平均结果。
PSNR* ROI 使用 Composite 的动态区域；PSNR-S 使用 Composite 的静态区域，PSNR-SR 使用移除动态后的静态区域。ROI 按有效像素归一化；论文未明确归一化方式，另提供全图零填充分母结果。没有历史无遮挡真值，因此这些指标不评估删除孔洞的补全质量。
视频由已完成评估图片CPU编码；不重新加载或修改训练状态。
训练链从父 run 完整10k节点恢复；10k展示父run结果，20–50k展示子run结果。失败父run在10k后的未保存步骤不进入本报告。
相同seed0与50k训练配置保留；恢复使用已验收的基础设施版本。此报告不声称CUDA训练轨迹逐位等价。
